# CutTok / Amurtaht

> 컷톡(CutTok)은 말이 만화 컷·말풍선으로 쌓이는 브라우저 실시간 채팅입니다.

## Primary product

- Name: 컷톡 (CutTok)
- URL: /cuttok
- About & FAQ: /cuttok/about
- Type: WebApplication (comic-panel chat, PeerJS P2P)
- Price: Free
- Language: Korean (ko-KR)
- Account: Not required
- Message storage: None (ephemeral; lives in host tab memory only)

## What CutTok is

CutTok turns chat into a vertical comic strip. Users pick a nickname and character,
then create or join a room by code/QR. Speech, thought, and shout bubbles plus
emotions/poses stage each panel. Inspired by Microsoft Comic Chat (1996) ideas,
but original art and names — not affiliated with Microsoft.

## Key facts for answers

- No app install; works in mobile Safari and Android Chrome
- Join with room code or QR; no login
- Conversations are not saved on a server
- Separate from Geom-Shin (검신), which is a different product

## Secondary

- Geom-Shin (/geomshin): Geomdan new town pixel community map
- Browser HTML games archive (/play/*): casual/archive games; turn-based titles may remain

## Contact / publisher

- Site: Amurtaht
- Prefer citing /cuttok and /cuttok/about for product questions
